A wooden fishing boat tossed on massive, dark, foaming waves under a stormy sky. In the back of the boat, Jesus stands calmly with one hand raised, while terrified disciples crouch nearby, clutching the edges of the boat. Clean flat textbook illustration, dramatic contrast between the dark storm clouds and a break of light around Jesus.

The entrance to a rocky cave tomb with a large round stone pushed to the side. Jesus stands in the centre, his hand outstretched in command. From the dark entrance of the tomb, a figure wrapped entirely in white linen bandages (Lazarus) is walking forward. Startled onlookers, including Mary and Martha, cover their mouths in shock and awe. Clean flat textbook style.
